reference_provenance.subject: cannonback
reference_provenance.prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Cannonback modeling reference using the supplied established front reference crop and complete installed-model three-quarter render only as species identity. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of the SAME massive sturdy quadrupedal turtle: squat broad dark azure/slate-blue head with a rounded short muzzle, small expressive amber-brown eyes, a calm confident closed-mouth expression, cream-beige segmented throat and belly, four thick short blue limbs with broad grounded feet and small pale claws, a heavy coherent layered stone-like blue-grey and natural ochre shell. Preserve its distinctive grouped short hollow dorsal tubes integrated into the shell as shown in the references; solid thick rims and shallow dark interiors, the same clustered turtle silhouette, no new gun equipment, barrels growing from the head, extra turrets or detached pipes. Keep the existing blue, cream, grey and restrained warm ochre colour organization, no neon or molten lava. Neutral riggable stance with FOUR full limbs and complete feet clearly separate, front and rear limb roots readable beneath the shell, each sole resting on the studio floor, natural supported head/neck, no limbs tucked under the belly. The shell plates and tubes must stay a substantial connected dorsal mass with broad joins, not floating rock shards or tiny detached islands. Simplify noisy mottling into large readable blue and ochre surface groups while preserving stone-like organic texture; soft roughness, no polished metal or plastic finish. Full head, tube cluster, shell, four feet and any existing small tail entirely inside the frame with generous margin. Clean detailed stylized game creature, plain light-grey studio background and floor, soft neutral studio lighting. No humans, text, rulers, boards, armour straps, harness, saddle, ropes, weapons or environment. One existing roster creature only, not a new species or an ordinary tortoise redesign.

inspection.identity: Installed dark blue quadrupedal turtle, cream segmented throat/belly, amber eye and coherent grey-blue/ochre shell with grouped hollow dorsal tubes retained
inspection.riggability: Four separated complete feet, clear limb roots and supported head/neck; tubes have broad shell joins and thick rims
inspection.limits: Dorsal tube cavities/plate connectivity, foot segmentation and protected shell skin ownership need generated/native inspection; no full art pass from reference.

rights.basis: Owner-held installed identity and original drafted reference; owner-authorized paid Meshy account. No purchase or community publication.
